implementation: Fresh recognized jobs use a v3 controller containing the bounded original v2 base plan plus fixed page/cursor/counter fields. One raw tenant-scoped identity:visitor page of at most32 keys is read per invocation. Current shopper matches absent from base discovery become a frozen v2 cleanup capsule with at most32 extra visitors and the canonical shopper retained only for ownership validation. Full capsules and input/output cursors are saved before root cursor CAS; all pages precede cleanup. Cursor-derived hashed page keys reject empty-page cursor cycles without a growing in-memory/controller cursor collection and reuse accepted pages after ambiguous writes. Extra capsules omit every canonical shopper step and every canonical-owned session; an excluded session must already be covered by a matching frozen base session or discovery conflicts. Extra target keys must fall inside their page's lexical interval. Root checkpoints compaction intent before child plan/cursor metadata is compacted, then advances to the next page; base cleanup runs last. The same32 attempted-step budget covers child and base execution. Receipts remain complete:false and label current-batch scope alongside page/extra completion counters.
legacy_semantics: Pending v1/v2 jobs retain their exact schemas, numeric cursors and step order. The existing v2 CACHE recovery test explicitly extracts the frozen base v2 plan and saves that historical wire form before exercising nonzero cursor recovery; v1 similarly reconstructs its exact historical wire schema from the captured base. Small recognized one-page/no-extra jobs still complete synchronously where the existing32-step limit permits. Fresh unrecognized selectors retain v2.
